trigger_conditions: In Andrea Cimi’s methodology, a **Failed Auction** is a market phenomenon where
price attempts to move beyond a established range or "fair value" but fails to
attract the participation necessary to sustain a trend [1-3].
A Failed Auction (also referred to as a "statistical anomaly") occurs when the
outcome: market enters a phase of price discovery outside of the **Value Area** (the range where 70% of volume is traded) but fails to find "acceptance" at those new prices [1, 4, 5]. Instead of forming a new range, the market rejects the extension and reverts to the previous area of balance [1, 6]. ### **2.
